name: Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd operates within the video intelligence domain, delivering a diverse range of software products and specialized solutions. Its portfolio encompasses an Operation Management System, meticulously designed for managing multimedia content across the internet. For enhanced connectivity, the company offers Multi-Screen Interactive solutions, seamlessly linking mobile devices with televisions. Enterprises can also benefit from their Electronic Work Order System, which efficiently defines workflows and manages resources. Furthermore, Wondertek provides advanced Video Encoding and Transcoding products, supporting online conversion for high-definition (HD), 4K, and High Dynamic Range (HDR) video formats. Other key offerings include a Content Propagation Matrix System, a robust platform for multi-channel content distribution, and Client Middleware, which serves as a powerful cross-platform engine for application development. The Converged Media Asset System stands out as an integrated multimedia management platform, capable of handling petabyte-level storage, diverse formats, and sophisticated retrieval operations. Rounding out their offerings, the Smart Super Business System incorporates cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology. Founded in 2009, Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd is based in Shanghai, China.
